cases.sentence: Подумай, прежде чем что-то сказать перед ___.
cases.translation: Think before saying something to God.
cases.explain: After the preposition "перед" (before), use the Instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Бог на ___, а ты на земле.
cases.translation: God is in heaven, and you are on earth.
cases.explain: After the preposition "на" (in/on) indicating location, use the Prepositional case.

cases.translation: Do not delay to fulfill your vow.
cases.explain: Direct object of the transitive verb "исполнить" (fulfill) requires the Accusative case.

cases.sentence: Не позволяй ___ ввести тебя в грех.
cases.translation: Do not allow your mouth to lead you into sin.
cases.explain: After the verb "позволяй" (allow), use the Dative case.

cases.sentence: Кто любит ___, тому его никогда не хватает.
cases.translation: He who loves money never has enough.
cases.explain: Direct object of the transitive verb "любит" (loves) requires the Accusative case.

cases.sentence: Когда увеличивается ___, увеличивается и число нахлебников.
cases.translation: When property increases, the number of dependents also increases.
cases.explain: Subject of the verb "увеличивается" (increases) is in the Nominative case.

cases.translation: Naked a man comes out of his mother's womb.
cases.explain: After the preposition "из" (out of), use the Genitive case.

cases.sentence: Каким человек пришел, таким и отходит от ___.
cases.translation: As a man came, so he departs from his labor.
cases.explain: After the preposition "от" (from), use the Genitive case.

reading.ru: Не торопись произнести слово перед Богом.
reading.question: What does Ecclesiastes advise about speaking before God?
options: Do not rush to speak before God
reading.correct: Do not rush to speak before God
reading.explain: The text advises to not rush to speak before God.

reading.ru: Когда даешь обет Богу, не замедли исполнить его.
reading.question: What should you do when you make a vow to God?
options: Do not delay in fulfilling it
reading.correct: Do not delay in fulfilling it
reading.explain: The text says not to delay in fulfilling a vow to God.

reading.ru: Лучше не давать обещания, чем дать и не исполнить.
reading.question: Which is better according to the text?
options: To not make a promise rather than make and break it
To make promises only to friends
reading.correct: To not make a promise rather than make and break it
reading.explain: Better not to promise than to promise and not fulfill.

reading.ru: Кто любит деньги, тому их никогда не хватает.
reading.question: What is said about lovers of money?
options: They are never satisfied with money
reading.correct: They are never satisfied with money
reading.explain: He who loves money never has enough.

reading.ru: Нагим человек выходит из утробы матери.
reading.question: How does man come into the world?
reading.explain: Naked a man comes out of his mother's womb.

reading.ru: Каким человек пришел, таким и уходит.
reading.question: What parallels are drawn about human life?
options: He grows in wisdom and wealth
He comes and goes the same way
reading.correct: He comes and goes the same way
reading.explain: As man came, so he goes.
